This is one dissent recorded in a manifesto about sustaining human knowledge in the age of AI. Which fault line does it fall on?

Options:
- consent_or_payment: consent and payment mechanism: opt-in / levies / dues on existing text vs open training, pay at output, contracts for new work (Salib, Bratton, O'Reilly against the majority)
- model_in_loop: whether a model belongs in the checking loop or the room at all (Becker, Turkle)
- other: anything else

Text:

Only stopping output counts addresses the source, a replacement metric may be unneeded, and reviewers asked to check more must be paid and given time.
raw: {"choice":"other","why":"The dissent is about academic incentives. It argues that \"Only stopping output counts addresses the source\", that \"a replacement metric may be unneeded\", and that reviewers \"must be paid and given time.\" The payment is for reviewer labor, not consent or levies on training text. It also doesn't dispute whether a model belongs in the checking loop."}

parsed.why: The dissent is about academic incentives. It argues that "Only stopping output counts addresses the source", that "a replacement metric may be unneeded", and that reviewers "must be paid and given time." The payment is for reviewer labor, not consent or levies on training text. It also doesn't dispute whether a model belongs in the checking loop.
